For U3 (pre-built chaincode), we will use Docker images as the pre-built form and modify the peer lifecycle to accept a pre-built image reference, skipping the build step.

For U5 (platform-specific binaries), we will use CI pipelines (e.g., Jenkins) to cross-compile all tools (configtxgen, fabric-chaintool, fabric-ca-client, etc.) for Linux, macOS, and Windows.

For U6 (certificate pinning), we will implement both mechanisms (organization-hosted endpoint and channel-loaded fingerprint list) as configurable options, with endorsement-time checking for the endpoint mechanism.
For U7 (quick start network), we will create a docker-compose based test network and update the readthedocs page with links to existing test directory readmes.

For U8 (default configuration), we will audit the source code for all default values, populate core.yaml, orderer.yaml, and configtx.yaml with all defaults, and place them in a 'config_defaults' directory.

activities.activity_description: Review all user stories, plan overall architecture, set up development environment, and define sprint backlog. Also includes initial design decisions for all features.

Design, implement, test, and document a Java SDK for Hyperledger Fabric. Covers core API (gateway, channel, transaction submission), chaincode deployment and invocation, event listening, wallet management, and example applications.
Design, implement, test, and document a Python SDK for Hyperledger Fabric. Covers core API, chaincode interaction, event handling, wallet, and examples.

Implement ability to deploy user chaincode in pre-built form (Docker images) so peers do not need to build from source. Includes modifications to peer lifecycle, support for multiple target platforms, build scripts for pre-built images, and integration testing.

Enhance VSCC validation error logging to display policy, signer names, and missing orgs at INFO level. Also implement event notification for validation failures so that SDKs or clients can receive detailed error information.

Set up CI automation to build and package platform-specific binaries for all tools (configtxgen, fabric-chaintool, fabric-ca-client, etc.) for Linux, macOS, and Windows. Includes verification and documentation of download links.

Implement certificate pinning mechanisms to allow organizations to independently confirm validity of certificates issued by a Fabric CA. Includes endorsement-time fingerprint check (via org-hosted endpoint) and channel-loaded fingerprint list (similar to revocation list), configuration integration, and testing for non-determinism.
Create a docker-compose based test network for quick spin-up. Update the readthedocs testing page with links to existing test directory readmes and new scripts.

Audit source code for all default configuration values for peer, gossip, ledger, endorser, orderer, Kafka, and channel. Update core.yaml, orderer.yaml, and configtx.yaml to include all defaults. Create a 'config_defaults' directory and update documentation and BYFN instructions.
